tagline: 理光便携相机，1993 年发布
description: 理光于1993年推出的便携相机。配备Ricoh Lens 35mm f/4.5, 3 elements in 3 groups。快门速度mechanical, 1/125 sec. (fixed-speed)。感光度manual setting, ISO 100 / 200 / 400 / 1000。fixed focus with infinity setting facility。

specs.镜头: Ricoh Lens 35mm f/4.5, 3 elements in 3 groups
specs.对焦: fixed focus with infinity setting facility
specs.曝光测光: fixed exposureA particular aperture is selected according the film speed regardless of the light conditions
specs.闪光灯: automatically activated in dim light conditions, no flash-off facility

The YF-20X is a fixed-focus point-and-shoot camera for 35mm film, introduced by Japanese manufacturer Ricoh in 1993.
